stem: A pre-use check finds a missing machine guard. What is the best response?

stimulus.alt: Operator-care versus servicing boundary diagram separating assigned routine cleaning and external checks from guard removal, disassembly, jam clearing, electrical access, and other protected servicing work.
stimulus.caption: Use the operator-care boundary to decide whether the failed safeguard can be compensated for by routine work behavior.

choices: Ask a coworker to watch the moving part
Do not use it; follow the out-of-service/escalation procedure
rationale: Missing safeguards are not compensated for by careful behavior; the equipment should not be used until properly addressed.
